title: Bag of bricks- Dark Blue 19
descriptionHtml:
Dark Blue — colour 19

A strong, confident navy. Dark Blue holds large areas without becoming monotonous, which makes it a reliable choice for backgrounds, uniforms and deep ocean.

Works well with: Deep Blue 13, Sapphire Blue 33, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Dark Blue bricks (colour 19) for Memobrick mosaics. A strong navy for deep water, evening skies and bold blocks of colour.
